info.name: BOM
info.description:
BOM flow — API test cases, grouped by test category.

Folders: **Positive / Negative / Boundary / Business Logic**; inside each, one sub-folder per endpoint (A → R, in flow order).
Every request name starts with its case ID (A-P1, B-N4, Q-B1 …) so it maps 1:1 to the test-case sheet.

SETUP
1. Set `base_url`.
2. Run **Setup — Tokens**; each login stores its own token variable (cm_token, md_token, dm_token, other_token).
3. Set `bom_id`, `order_style_id`, `submission_id` and `bom_item_id` from seed data — there is no list/search-BOMs endpoint.
4. Before any PATCH /items, GET the BOM first: its test script stores the live `revision` into `base_revision` (the schema requires ge=1, so never send 0).

Watch-outs baked into the case descriptions: error shapes differ between router-level `{"detail"}` and service-level `{"error"}`; a malformed UUID path param 422s before any handler runs; Q-B1 is a confirmed 500; direct_manager bypasses every MD-only gate.

|---|---|
| Category | POS |

| Role | Any authenticated role |
| Endpoint group | L · Notifications |

**Request / steps**

- curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" {base_url}/api/v1/procurement/notifications/stream

**Expected result**

text/event-stream response: one "data: {...}\n\n" frame per currently-unread notification immediately on connect (each flips PENDING→SENT), then ": keep-alive\n\n" comment frames roughly every 10s, indefinitely, until the client disconnects. The -N flag is required or curl buffers the whole thing.
